keyFindings.description: Main's 'Never route such an issue' referred to line 46's 'An issue with the legion label, or under one'. The new 'never route a `legion` issue' drops 'or under one', and a Legion child carries no label. With this PR, a route also turns off the claimant and primary-document delivery (takesClaimRecipients), so an agent that routes a Legion child to itself now takes people's comments away from the tree's claimant. The skill is agent behaviour; fix: 'never route a `legion` issue or one under it'.
The entry says the skill says 'a thread the session wrote in brings people's replies'; 0937a91c removed that clause from SKILL.md:48. Remove it from the entry, or put it back in the skill.
